_meta.note: first 3 tests per parameter set; full official files have 100 tests each (the package carries no official KAT for the 653/1013 sizes). KAT randomness is the Bassham AES-256-CTR DRBG seeded per count: keygen consumes p 4-byte urandom32 draws for g, then p for f, then one (p+3)/4-byte rho draw; encapsulation consumes p 4-byte draws for r (see tests/common/mod.rs).
